name: MsoRelativeNodePosition
description: Specifies where a node is added to a diagram relative to existing nodes.

constants.name: msoBeforeNode
constants.description: Node is added before current node.

constants.name: msoAfterNode
constants.description: Node is added after current node.

constants.name: msoBeforeFirstSibling
constants.description: Node is added before first sibling.

constants.name: msoAfterLastSibling
constants.description: Node is added after last sibling.
